# The Independent

> A global news organization delivering breaking news, politics, and in-depth coverage across US, UK, Europe, and Asia with dedicated sections for sports, science, health, and lifestyle.

The Independent operates regional editions (US, Asia) and maintains comprehensive news coverage spanning politics, international affairs, sports, science, and consumer content. The site serves diverse audiences with specialized sections for breaking news, investigative journalism, and multimedia content including podcasts.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- US Politics
- Trump Administration
- UK News
- Europe News
- World News
- Premier League Football
- Crime & Justice
- Medical Research
- Science & Space
- Iran Conflict
- Ukraine Crisis
- Asia News
- Sports Coverage
- International Affairs

## News Editions & Homepages

- [The Independent | Latest news and features from US, UK and worldwide](https://www.independent.co.uk): Main homepage with breaking news, politics, and international coverage
- [The Independent | Latest news and features from US, UK and worldwide](https://www.independent.co.uk/us): US edition homepage with breaking news, politics, and worldwide coverage
- [Independent Asia Edition](https://www.independent.co.uk/asia): Asia regional edition covering India, Korea, and East Asian news

## Global News Coverage

- [World | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world): World news homepage with international politics and regional conflicts
- [UK | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk): UK news section with politics, crime, health, and current events
- [Europe | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe): Europe news covering Ukraine-Russia war and geopolitical affairs
- [Americas | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas): Americas news section with US politics, Trump, and regional coverage

## Politics & Government

- [US Politics | Latest news, comment and analysis](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics): US politics coverage with election, Senate, and policy analysis
- [US Crime News | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime): US crime news section covering criminal cases and law enforcement

## Sports

- [Sport latest news, live results, updates and comment | Sport](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport): Sports homepage with football, tennis, F1, golf, and rugby coverage
- [Football – The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football): Football news with Premier League, Champions League, and transfers
- [US Sport | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/us-sport): US sports section covering soccer, World Cup 2026, and Olympics

## Science, Health & Environment

- [Science | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science): Science news with latest discoveries in evolution, research, and tech
- [Space news - SpaceX, Nasa, meteors, moons and more](https://www.independent.co.uk/space): Space news covering NASA, SpaceX, astronomy, and moon exploration
- [Health | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health): Health news covering medical research, disease prevention, and policy

## Multimedia & Engagement

- [Podcasts | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/podcasts): Podcast directory covering politics, culture, health, and travel
- [Newsletter Preferences | The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/newsletters): Newsletter subscription and preference management for news briefings

## Optional

- [US Money & Personal Finance](https://www.independent.co.uk/us/money): Personal finance, money management, and consumer news for US readers
- [Rethinking Global Aid - latest news, breaking stories and comment - The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/topic/rethinking-global-aid): Topic coverage on global aid, development, and humanitarian crisis
